implementation_role: candidate entry lift; implementer did not review this artifact
solution_concept: perfect Bayesian equilibrium with a collective all-or-nothing weak-state formation decision layered assessment by assessment on the frozen C1 majority correspondence
native_payoff_date: entry date, with imported C1 payoffs already in Round-1 units

domain.entry_cost: chi>=0, paid separately by every weak identity if and only if the institution forms
domain.weak_information: the weak coalition does not observe theta at entry
domain.formation_technology: collective and all-or-nothing; there is no identity-level unilateral entry decision
domain.nonformation: every weak identity receives zero and H type theta receives o_theta
domain.equality: the weak coalition forms when its collective net value equals zero

upstream_consumption.unit: one complete identity-indexed C1-M assessment alpha=(alpha_1,...,alpha_m), including every proposal mixture, ballot strategy and completion, belief, posterior, continuation selection, type-by-identity payoff, payment, inclusion, opt-out, full history, and outcome distribution
upstream_consumption.preservation: alpha is retained whole as a coordinate of the entry assessment and is never chosen, spliced, or replaced by a scalar bound
upstream_consumption.no_rederivation: no R1 or C2 strategy, belief, payoff, or equilibrium condition is rederived or repaired here
upstream_consumption.discount: no additional beta is applied because C1-M is already dated in Round-1 units
upstream_consumption.true_belief: entry uses true mu, never a proposal-contingent ballot belief rho

collective_value_operator.sigma_first: for each recognized proposer i, type theta, and named player k, integrate U_k^{i,theta} over the complete proposal mixture sigma_i inside alpha_i
collective_value_operator.type_third: C1_M,W_j^alpha(mu|h1)=(1-mu)C1_M,W_j^alpha(0|h1)+mu C1_M,W_j^alpha(1|h1) for each named weak identity j
collective_value_operator.linearity_note: the two displayed formulas are identical by finite-sum linearity; the computational contract is E_sigma, then recognition, then type integration, then cross-weak averaging
collective_value_operator.forbidden_projection: the recognized-proposer payoff, its N=3 singleton or interval, and the proved [0,1] proposer projections are not collective weak values

assessment_level_entry_rule.decision: form if and only if V_W^M(alpha,mu)>=chi; equality forms
assessment_level_entry_rule.collective_interpretation: the rule maximizes the average payoff of the collective weak-state formation device; it does not add an unmodeled individual participation veto
assessment_level_entry_rule.formed_named_weak_type_payoff: E_M,W_j^alpha(theta)=C1_M,W_j^alpha(theta|h1)-chi for every named j and theta
assessment_level_entry_rule.formed_named_weak_ex_ante_payoff: E_M,W_j^alpha(mu)=C1_M,W_j^alpha(mu|h1)-chi; negative identity-level net payoffs are retained and never truncated
assessment_level_entry_rule.formed_outcome: inherit alpha's complete type-conditional C1-M outcome distribution and append formed status plus an external cost ledger chi for each named weak identity
assessment_level_entry_rule.nonformed_named_weak_payoff: E_M,W_j(theta)=0 for every named j and theta
assessment_level_entry_rule.nonformed_outcome: collective_nonformation; H excluded; no institutional allocation, proposal, ballot, R1, or R2 is realized
assessment_level_entry_rule.external_cost_accounting: chi is sunk and external: it does not reduce the institutional pie, change gifts, transfer to H, enter a ballot IC, or receive beta

exact_entry_correspondence.assessment_set: A_M(h1) is the full nonempty frozen C1-M assessment correspondence at the entry history
exact_entry_correspondence.object: E_M(h0,mu,chi) contains, for every whole alpha in A_M(h1), alpha itself, V_W, V_W-chi, the deterministic formation status, all type-by-identity entry payoffs, H type payoffs, cost ledger, and the complete inherited or nonformation outcome distribution
exact_entry_correspondence.necessity: any entry PBE fixes a complete off-path-or-on-path C1-M assessment alpha and the collective action must obey the displayed comparison
exact_entry_correspondence.sufficiency: for every alpha in A_M, the prescribed collective action plus alpha after formation and the primitive nonformation terminal outcome is sequentially rational
exact_entry_correspondence.selection_status: set-valued assessment by assessment; no assessment is selected by an infimum, supremum, average over assessments, or proposer-payoff projection

selection_free_bounds.value_set: S_M(mu)={V_W^M(alpha,mu): alpha in A_M(h1)} is nonempty
selection_free_bounds.attainment_flags: a_M^- and a_M^+ separately record whether some complete alpha attains v_M^- or v_M^+; no compactness or attainment is presumed unless proved
selection_free_bounds.resource_proof_basis: on every PR04-PR07 realization the aggregate weak gross payoff is nonnegative and at most one in Round-1 units; sigma, ballot, recognition, and type integration preserve that bound
selection_free_bounds.N_at_least_4_upper_endpoint: for every N>=4, v_M^+=1/m and a_M^+=true because the frozen value-one assessment gives aggregate weak gross payoff one in every type
selection_free_bounds.N_equals_3_endpoint_status: the frozen proposer projection does not identify v_M^- or v_M^+; beyond the resource envelope and assessment-level formula, endpoint values and attainment must be computed from complete alpha objects
selection_free_bounds.lower_endpoint_status: no universal exact value or attainment claim is made for v_M^-
selection_free_bounds.proposer_projection_construction_note: in every proved [0,1] proposer-payoff construction, y=0, gifts total 1-V, and current passage give aggregate weak gross payoff one, hence collective value 1/m for every proposer payoff V; that continuum does not widen the collective value by itself

formation_regions.lower_attainment_equality: at chi=v_M^- every assessment forms, whether or not the infimum is attained, because every value is at least the infimum and equality forms
formation_regions.upper_attainment_equality: at chi=v_M^+ formation is possible exactly when the supremum is attained; otherwise every assessment has V_W<chi and all choose no
formation_regions.universal_cost_implications: chi=0 implies all form; chi>1/m implies all no; for N>=4, chi=1/m admits formation through the attained value-one assessment
formation_regions.nonattainment_warning: possible formation at the upper endpoint may not be inferred from a supremum alone

N3_proposer_projection_counterexample.double_tied_proposals: the weak-no proposal (y,x)=(0,0) and weak-yes proposal (0,.675) both give the recognized proposer .325 and H .72
N3_proposer_projection_counterexample.first_collective_value: weak-no yields aggregate weak gross .55 ex ante and V_W=.275
N3_proposer_projection_counterexample.second_collective_value: weak-yes yields aggregate weak gross one ex ante and V_W=.5
N3_proposer_projection_counterexample.mixing: any mixture of the double-tied signatures preserves proposer .325 and H .72 while spanning collective values [.275,.5]
N3_proposer_projection_counterexample.implication: even a fixed proposer value and tie-minimal H payoff do not determine entry; the complete type-by-identity alpha is indispensable

boundary_cases: N=3 remains in the validated domain, but its proposer-value interval is never substituted for collective weak value
mu=0 or mu=1 uses the applicable type coordinate while retaining the counterfactual coordinate inside alpha
chi=0 forms even at zero gross value because equality forms
chi=v_M^- is all-form irrespective of lower-endpoint attainment
chi=v_M^+ requires the upper-attainment flag for possible formation
for N>=4, chi=1/m has at least one forming assessment
formed identity-level net payoffs may be negative under the collective average criterion
nonformation pays H o_theta without beta and pays every weak identity zero
rejected_shortcuts: using a recognized-proposer payoff as V_W
using the N=3 proposer singleton or interval as an entry region
using the [0,1] proposer projection as a collective-value interval
choosing one C1 assessment from lower or upper bounds
discarding identity coordinates before sigma and recognition integration
adding an individual weak-state participation constraint
charging chi inside the institutional pie
discounting C1 or the entry cost again

verification.scope: exact dependency and transitive-component hashes; mutation invalidation; E_sigma to recognition to type to cross-weak aggregation; asymmetric named identities and proposal mixing; equality; external cost; negative identity net payoff; nonformation; resource envelope; N>=4 attained upper endpoint; N=3 double-tie nonidentification; endpoint and nonattainment logic; 27 protected hashes

invalidation: any byte change to Gate 0, the frozen R1 batch, C1-M, or any transitive frozen component invalidates this candidate and every descendant
artifact_hash_policy: the exact UTF-8 JSON bytes are hashed externally after serialization; no self-referential hash is embedded
